user.title: Add Kramer AV device
user.description: Protocol 2000 or 3000. Port 0 selects TCP 5000 or UDP 50000. Detection performs read-only requests and does not switch a device protocol.

data_description.port: 0 = default for TCP or UDP. Override if your device uses a custom port.
data_description.protocol: Automatic checks Protocol 3000 first, then Protocol 2000 over TCP.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Kramer AV device
reconfigure.description: Change connection settings. The same protocol/device must respond; no protocol mode is changed on the hardware.

data_description.port: 0 = default for TCP or UDP. Override if your device uses a custom port.
data_description.protocol: Automatic checks Protocol 3000 first, then Protocol 2000 over TCP.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect or receive a Protocol 3000 model response
error.not_protocol_3000: The device did not identify itself using Protocol 3000
error.invalid_configuration: Unsupported transport, protocol, or I/O counts
error.wrong_device: The new address does not match the existing Kramer device
error.protocol_change_not_supported: To change the protocol, remove and re-add the device

abort.already_configured: This address and protocol are already configured

init.title: Kramer AV options
init.description: Comma-separated friendly names in physical port order. Leave an item blank to retain its numeric label. Names are suffixes, e.g. 'Input 1 — PC'.
